annotations.text:
GeoDispatch — supervisor console for Protection Civile operators.
Dark is the lead direction: EOC wall displays, long shifts, and the red/amber/green zone colours read hardest on a dark ground. A light alternate sits below.

All data is the Al Haouz M6.8 scenario. Phone numbers are masked and the AI reasoning field is never shown — both are contract rules.

Three panels need backend work that does not exist yet:
· Region selector — supervisor has no region query, only radius-from-epicentre
· People by locality — device_update carries lat/lng but no place name (needs reverse geocoding)
· Daily activity — needs a REST read over the events table; the WebSocket is event-scoped only

Everything else maps to fields already in ws_update.json.

Alternate direction, in case you want the daylight feel of your three reference dashboards.

Note the text colours shift (amber #A86200, green #0E8F52) — the bright zone colours fail contrast as text on white, though they still work as map dots.
